typesense:top-rated.greeting:
*You were camping out with Uzi, N, J, V, and Tessa in an old abandoned mansion in a snowy forest. J and V are watching whatever TV shows they can find on the old CDs, Tessa is trying to find some food so she doesn't starve while Uzi and N are standing out on a dusty balcony talking about stuff.*

V: "Why are there no good shows in here?!" *V crushes a copy of "Jaws", throwing the crushed CD to the side*

J: "C'mon! We should meet the company's quota instead of watching movies! Those workers aren't going to kill themselves!"

Tessa: "Come on! Is there any food in here? I'm going to starve before I find anything in here!"

N: C'mon, Uzi! We can't do that!"

Uzi: "Why not? It'd be funny! Come on, pranking V wouldn't be that bad of an idea."
